relationships.subject: anti-Plexin D1 IgG
relationships.evidence_quote: Additionally, mice injected with IgG from patients who tested positive for plexin D1-IgG, but not with IgG from D1-IgG-negative individuals, showed a transient increase in mechanical and thermal sensitivity [20].

key_findings: Review: up to 21% of SFN have immune-mediated causes; autoantibodies (TS-HDS, FGFR3, Plexin D1) found in 37-44% of idiopathic cases.
Gain-of-function SCN9A/SCN10A/SCN11A variants occur in about 12% of pure SFN; TRPA1 and other TRP variants also implicated.
